title: Newegg, The RealReal team with Google for conversational AI shopping
source_used: PR Newswire (The RealReal press release, 8 Oct 2026)
key_facts: The RealReal (NASDAQ: REAL) said on 8 Oct 2026 it is expanding Ask TRR, its AI shopping agent built with Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise, to all 45 million members after a pilot.
Shoppers ask in natural language, for example 'What luxury bag should I buy?', and get tailored recommendations.
The RealReal says every item is one-of-one and it has more than 1.5 million unique pieces on its site every day.
It plans AI-driven recommendations on product description pages.
Google Cloud's Darshan Kantak says the retailer is ahead of the shift to agentic AI in retail.
The Newegg side of the Chain Store Age story (headline: 'Newegg, The RealReal team with Google for conversational AI shopping') could not be read.
quote_evidence: The RealReal (NASDAQ: REAL ) today announced it is expanding Ask TRR, the online retailer's AI shopping agent built with Google Cloud's Gemini Enterprise.

Officially launching to all 45 million members after a successful pilot, Ask TRR marks a significant step in The RealReal's mission to make luxury resale more personalized and intuitive in the agentic era.
why_it_matters_hint: Online shops are moving from keyword search to chat-style shopping agents built on Google's enterprise AI.
notes: Chain Store Age returned 403, so what Newegg is doing is unknown. The RealReal facts come from its own press release (company claims). Entry built from the Chain Store Age headline plus the press release.
